assertion: 登录、创建/修改/删除 Script、Task、Schedule、Artifact、Application（按用户角色权限验证）。
login: all three roles logged in through the Web UI; /api/me returned the expected Role (evidence/P1902-00-login-all-roles.json)
admin_crud: create/delete driven through the real UI for all five resources; modify driven through the UI for Script (r1->r2), Task (r1->r2), Schedule (r1->r2) and Application (r1->r2). Artifact has no update endpoint/API (delete + re-upload only) (evidence/P1902-17-admin-crud-summary.json + evidence/P1902-18-mutation-requests.txt)

operator.task_run_meaning: permission granted (canRun) -> request reached the run path and failed only with 'no target nodes' on a node-less instance; viewer gets 403

operator.scripts/tasks/schedules/artifacts/applic: no create link (/new), no upload input, no edit/delete menus in rows
operator.tasks page: run control present (link /tasks/{id}/run); 0 row more-menus; run action reaches backend (toast 'no target nodes')

viewer.scripts/tasks/schedules/artifacts/applic: no create link, no upload input, no row action controls
viewer.tasks page: no run control, empty actions cell

no_side_effects.method: snapshot GET /api/{scripts,tasks,schedules,artifacts,applications} before/after all denied operator+viewer attempts

limitations: This isolated instance has no enrolled agents, so Task/Schedule creation used a label target on the real UI form; 'run' cannot produce real executions (no target nodes).
Artifact has no update API/endpoint by design, so artifact 'modify' is not applicable; create (upload) and delete were exercised.
Application 'modify' exercised via the UI edit form; there is no separate revert/archive action on this build.
